body.draft-comment: Go to Tools menu and click Track Changes, before you to start making any edits.

Go to Tools menu and click Accept or Reject Changes. Select Accept All in the pop-up window, before you start making edits for next revision. If the changes is common between SKUs or other platforms keep it as is to indicate it other SKU revision.
body.p:
The guidelines here are to support a
dual sided component assembly.
The expectation is that the DRAM decoupling caps will be placed as close as possible to the DRAM devices to minimize the loop inductance of the caps.
The decoupling capacitor to DRAM device inductance loop can be improved by following common power integrity recommendations described in Power Integrity Recommendations.
